formulations.Polymer system Notes: Poly(ethylene carbonate) (PEC) with a carbonate unit to total unit ratio of approximately 95%.
formulations.Transference notes: The highest transference number was measured at 80 mol% salt concentration.
formulations.Notes: The PEC was dissolved in acetonitrile with Li salts. The solution was cast and dried in a vacuum at 60°C for 24 hours.
formulations.Reference: Journal of The Electrochemical Society, 162 (2) A3133-A3136 (2015)
